description: Lists the Plot Speaks stories and games that can be played by voice, three at a time with a one-line pitch each; the page argument gives the next three. Narrow it by a collection (Murder Mysteries, Greek Myths, Classic Detectives, Horror and Ghosts, Seasons, Holiday Specials, Bedtime, Dice Games, Road Trip, Read-Aloud Classics, Written by players), by length (max_minutes), by what's new (new: true), by kind (mysteries, adventures, choose-your-path stories, trivia, guessing games, game shows, dice games, word games, party and storytelling games, Table Talk, Story Time read-alouds, wind-downs, open worlds and campaigns) or, within mysteries, classic or dark. With group_by_category and no page it returns the whole catalogue under kind headings. An unknown kind or collection returns a message naming the valid ones.

audience.description: Narrow by audience: general, or the all-ages pieces. Omit for everything

collection.description: A collection, by name or id, loosely matched: greek-myths, classic-detectives, ghost-gothic, seasons, holidays, bedtime, dice, road-trip, classics, players. Examples: "Greek Myths", "detective stories".

genre.description: Within mysteries and adventures: murder-mystery (all murder mysteries), classic (murder mysteries that aren't dark), dark (dark murder mysteries) or adventure

group_by_category.description: True, with no page, for the whole list grouped under kind headings

kind.description: Only list this kind: mystery, adventure, branching (choose your path), trivia, guessing (guessing games), gameshow (game shows), dice (dice games), word (word games), party (party and storytelling), talk (Table Talk), story time (read-aloud classics), winddown (wind-downs), campaign (open worlds and D&D-style campaigns), or game (every one of the game kinds above except trivia and guessing)

max_minutes.description: Only pieces this many minutes long or shorter

new.description: True for what's new: the newest pieces first, with their What's New line

not_played.description: True to leave out what this player has already played (signed-in players only)

page.description: Which page of three to return, from 1; page 2 gives items 4 to 6 of the same filtered list. Each result states the page and total pages

name: list_stories
title: List stories
